notes: Only page 1 builds this set (steps 1-9). Page 2 shows combining with set 8655 and uses pieces not in this set's list, so it is ignored.
The booklet images are small, so exact stud positions, and some rests_on relations, are best-guess. Piece counts match the parts list (32).
Step 2 is assumed to be a 2x6 black plate with a DBG side-handle plate (b2) and a DBG 1x2 plate (b3) on it. Step 3 is the two 2x2 pin bricks, one pin on each side.
Step 4 is the DBG 2x6 plate plus the 1x2-2x2 bracket (b7) at the front end. Step 5 is the red 2x3 and black 2x4 plates plus two side-handle plates at the back.

The scoop pair (b13, b14) on a DBG 2x4 plate (b12) over the two handles is assumed to be part of step 6. The step 6 box holds a black 2x2 plate (b15) and a black 2x2 plate (b16) carrying the grille tile and two clear round plates.
Step 7 adds the curved bricks (b20, b22) and a DBG 1x2 plate (b21). Step 8 adds the 2x2 grooved tile. Step 9 adds 4 wheels with tyres on the pins, and the sticker sheet.
The sticker sheet is attached to the bonnet as a representative placement.
